name: Braintrust
short: LLM evaluation and observability platform with a free Starter tier (no credit card required).

plans.name: Starter (Free)
plans.notes: $10 model credits, 1 GB processed data, 10,000 scores, 14-day retention, unlimited users, projects, datasets, playgrounds, and experiments. No credit card required.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $100 model credits, 5 GB processed data, 50,000 scores, 30-day retention, custom charts, RBAC, priority support.
